about: Round 1600: what every modern club IS on the files as shipped (curve 1), read off the engine by scripts/simCmLevelReads.mjs --record: the best eleven bakedXIAvg ranks with (xi), the value scale of its projected men (scale), a digest of its slot anchors at year 0 (anchors), and for a club of a real league its tier, budget and the finish its board expects (exp).
